brief:
Palestinians in Israel have faced a wave of attacks following weeks of escalating hostility, Middle East Eye reported. Incidents include arson at a mosque, a suspected car-ramming attack, and racist graffiti targeting Palestinian communities across the country.

The attacks follow an intensifying incitement campaign, though the report does not detail the specific statements or actions comprising that campaign. Palestinian citizens of Israel have long reported discrimination and violence, with periodic surges correlating with periods of heightened political tension.

title: Netanyahu's incitement campaign sparks attacks on Palestinians in Israel
